title: 第2433章 红羽鹤第2432章 顶腰杆子
content_zh:
这知道的，清楚两人是异父异母的兄妹。
这不知道得，定然还以为萧易行这是在跟萧菲姚撒娇谈情说爱呢。
李落一个外人，看见这一幕实在是尴尬得无与伦比。
脚指头差点没把鞋子抠出个豪宅的同时，他只能埋头喝茶，以此来缓解尴尬。
而萧菲姚则微微皱了皱眉头，并轻声道：“大哥说这话，是不是对菲姚有什么成见？难道大哥认为，如果在外面遇到对大哥不尊重的人或者事，菲姚会袖手旁观？”
萧易行哈哈一笑。
开心道：“哥哥我跟你开玩笑的呢，你看看，你那认真的模样，实在是让哥哥伤心啊。”
话音刚落。
萧易行望向萧菲姚的目光，竟然变得温柔以及欣慰了起来。
“妹妹虽然以前不姓萧，但现在却是实打实的萧家人，时不时参与一下萧家的决策，给点建议也是可以的。”
不等萧菲姚接话。
萧易行转而望向李落道：“李前辈，我就听妹妹的话，给与你一定的支持，从今往后豢兽宗若是遇到什么解决不了的麻烦，你大可以派人或者寄出书信通知我，只要是我能力范围内能办到的事情，绝不推脱！”
虽说现在萧家的一切事宜，都是由萧易行的亲妹妹萧甄来主持和打理，但任谁都知道，萧家最终的家主之位，一定会传给那吊儿郎当的萧家大少爷。
毕竟萧青墨若不溺爱萧易行，早就把这个不成器的儿子赶出去了。
所以萧易行给出的保证，也是有一定含金量的。
李落当即便站起来拱手道谢。
而萧易行这次可没客气，坦然接受了一个老前辈的谢意。
一杯茶喝完。
李落和萧易行说话也稍微“大胆”了起来。
趁着萧菲姚给萧易行斟茶的时机。

他问道：“萧大少爷，不知宝鹤郡附近，可有什么比较稀有的鸟兽？”
对于珍奇异兽，萧易行历来都有着浓厚的兴趣。
当即便回道：“宝鹤郡以东二百里，有一处名为鹤来的山脉，里面有一种羽毛皆为红色的仙鹤，名为红羽鹤，这也是宝鹤郡名字的来由。”
李落当即便瞪大了眼睛道：“那红羽鹤，当真存在？”
萧易行点头道：“我去过鹤来山已经数十次了，曾有一两次见过那红羽鹤，奈何这种仙鹤实在是警惕，飞行速度又快得惊人，虽然我一直想要弄一只回来，但这数千年来从未成功过，加之平日里我还是比较忙的，所以心中一直有这么个结呢。”
说完。
萧易行定睛望着李落，显然是想要李落表示表示。
果不其然。
李落感受到萧易行那略显期许的目光后。
脸上突然浮现出自信之色。
“对于鸟兽这一道，老朽自认为天下没有人比老朽要厉害，所以如果公子能抽出时间，或者找人带路的话，兴许只需老朽去到那鹤来山瞧上一瞧，没准啊，公子心中的结就怎么打开了呢！”
李落一边说，一边挺起了胸膛，在萧菲姚看来，他此番言行举止颇有卖弄的意思。
可她的哥哥萧易行并不怎么认为。
估摸着是对那红羽鹤有执念的原因。
他的态度肉眼可见的热情了起来。
“这样的事情，怎么能让他人代劳呢？自然是由我亲自带前辈前往鹤来山！”
顿了顿。
萧易行继续道：“至于时间嘛，可以挤，有心的话，什么时候都能挤得出来，但是如李前辈这样在御兽以及豢兽一道上的顶级强者，可是很难遇到的！”
这马屁拍得够直接。
content_en:
You know, you know they are half-brothers and sisters.
I don't know, I must have thought that Xiao Yixing was having a love affair with Xiao Fei and Yao Sajiao.
Li Luo, an outsider, was extremely embarrassed when he saw this scene.
While his toes almost dug out of his shoes, he could only drink tea to relieve the embarrassment.
Xiao Feiyao frowned slightly and said softly: "When the elder brother said this, does he have any prejudice against Feiyao? Does the elder brother think that if someone or something disrespects the elder brother outside, Feiyao will stand by and watch?"
Xiao Yixing laughed.
He said happily: "Brother, I was joking with you. Look, your serious look really makes me sad."
The words just fell.
Xiao Yixing's eyes turned gentle and happy when he looked at Xiao Feiyao.
"Although my sister was not named Xiao before, she is now a real member of the Xiao family. It is okay to participate in the Xiao family's decision-making from time to time and give some suggestions."
Xiao Feiyao didn't wait for the answer.
Xiao Yixing turned to look at Li Luo and said: "Senior Li, I will listen to my sister and give you a certain amount of support. From now on, if the Bodhisattva Sect encounters any trouble that cannot be solved, you can send someone or send a letter to notify me. As long as it is something that I can do within my ability, I will never shirk it!"
Although all affairs of the Xiao family are now presided over and managed by Xiao Yixing's biological sister Xiao Zhen, everyone knows that the final position of the Xiao family head will definitely be passed on to the carefree eldest son of the Xiao family.
After all, if Xiao Qingmo didn't dote on Xiao Yixing, he would have driven this useless son out long ago.
Therefore, the guarantee given by Xiao Yixing also has a certain gold content.
Li Luodang stood up and thanked him with his hands.
Xiao Yixing was not polite this time and accepted the gratitude of an old senior calmly.
Finished a cup of tea.
Li Luo and Xiao Yixing also became a little "bold" in their speech.
Taking advantage of Xiao Feiyao's opportunity to pour tea for Xiao Yixing.
He asked: "Master Xiao, I wonder if there are any rare birds and beasts near Baohe County?"
Xiao Yixing has always had a strong interest in rare and exotic animals.
Dangjia replied: "Two hundred miles east of Baohe County, there is a mountain range called Helai. There is a kind of crane with red feathers in it, called the red-feathered crane. This is also the origin of the name of Baohe County."
Li Luodang's eyes widened and he said, "Does that red-feathered crane really exist?"
Xiao Yixing nodded and said: "I have been to Helai Mountain dozens of times, and I have seen the red-feathered crane once or twice. However, this kind of crane is really vigilant and flies at an amazingly fast speed. Although I have always wanted to get one back, I have never succeeded in thousands of years. In addition, I am quite busy on weekdays, so I always have this knot in my heart."
Finished.
Xiao Yixing looked at Li Luo intently, obviously wanting Li Luo to express his feelings.
Sure enough.
Li Luo felt Xiao Yixing's slightly expectant gaze.
A look of confidence suddenly appeared on his face.
"When it comes to birds and beasts, Lao Chan thinks that no one in the world is better than Lao Chan. So if the young master can spare some time or find someone to lead the way, maybe Lao Chan can just go to Helai Mountain and take a look. Maybe, the knot in the young master's heart will be opened!"
Li Luo puffed up his chest as he spoke. In Xiao Feiyao's opinion, his words and deeds were quite show off.
But her brother Xiao Yixing didn't think much of it.
Probably because of his obsession with the red-feathered crane.
His attitude became visibly enthusiastic.
"How can you let others do such a thing for you? Naturally, I will take senior to Helai Mountain myself!"
There was a pause.
Xiao Yixing continued: "As for time, you can squeeze it out. If you are willing, you can squeeze it out at any time, but a top expert like Senior Li who is master of beasts and beasts is very difficult to squeeze out.Hard to come across! "
This flattery is quite direct.
